title: Suits/Sandbox
summary:
__NOTOC__
This page is to help organize information about the different Suit teams in order to expound upon the current information.
----

 
Suits are the lowest level minions of the Organization. Typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level Organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Most Suits were banded together by [[the Professor]], practically overnight, through the use of [[Araknos|Araknos']] mind control ability. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}}
sections.text: Most Suits were banded together by the Professor, practically overnight, through the use of Araknos' mind control ability. [The Secret of Two Generations]

sections.heading: DeFoe's Suits
sections.text:
DeFoe had his Suits pursue Lok Lambert in an attempt to retrieve Eathon Lambert's journal and its secrets of the Amulet of Will. [A Seeker Is Born] Pursuing the Foundation's clue regarding the Golem, the Organization gained Jodis Lore's Key. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] The team was later sent to Rouen, France, to retrieve Gar-Ghoul. [Into the River of Secrets]

However, they missed the more important information on the Ring of Arc and were then sent by the Professor to Paris, France, following Dante's team into the Paris Catacombs. [Crawling the Catacombs] Despite gaining a number of new recruits from Paris, they were unsuccessful at retrieving the Ring. [Divide and Conquer]

His Suits were later sent after King Basilisk, but lost the Titan to Zhalia Moon. They also lost unnamed Suit 001 to a petrification trap within the Titan's chamber. [Absent Heroes]

Upon this failure, DeFoe lost command of his original team of Suits and thus had to rally his remaining loyal Suits within Velo, Greece, in an attempt to finally get his revenge on Dante Vale. This team failed and were escorted back under Grier. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

sections.heading: Grier's Suits
sections.wikitext:
Upon taking DeFoe's place of leadership within [[the Organization]], [[Grier]] had his Suits accompany him to [[Sutos Island]] in order to reclaim the rulership of the island. The Suits were led into a trap by [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]], and the two sides battled until [[Dante Vale]] and Grier announced a truce. His Suits were then permitted to help enforce order on Sutos in order to promote peace on the island. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

Two of Grier's Suits were attacked by four [[Silent Soldiers]] while loading a boat with supplies for Sutos. They were saved by Dante's team. Grier acknowledged that not all his men had been so lucky. His Suits later accompanied him to the Professor's Castle. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}}

The Suits were led into a trap by Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, and the two sides battled until Dante Vale and Grier announced a truce. His Suits were then permitted to help enforce order on Sutos in order to promote peace on the island. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

sections.heading: Klaus's Suits
sections.wikitext: Klaus' Viennese Suits were sent, under the instructions of Rassimov, to go after [[Dante Vale]] in [[County Kerry, Ireland]]. His team of Suits ambushed [[Scarlet Byrne]] and Dante's team in the [[New Grange Passage Tomb]] but were eventually defeated. {{source|Home Turf}} His Egyptian Suits were sent to excavate the [[tomb of Nefertiti]], and both groups were sent after the [[Sceptre of Nefertiti]], which was taken from the Foundation members after a skirmish. {{source|The Sceptre Deception}} During the mission to secure the Amulets of [[Vlad Dracul]], three of his Suits were transformed through the power of [[Overmode]]. Even with this power, however, they were defeated when [[Zhalia Moon]] chose to side with the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|The Vampire Loses Its Fangs}}
sections.text: Klaus' Viennese Suits were sent, under the instructions of Rassimov, to go after Dante Vale in County Kerry, Ireland. His team of Suits ambushed Scarlet Byrne and Dante's team in the New Grange Passage Tomb but were eventually defeated. [Home Turf] His Egyptian Suits were sent to excavate the tomb of Nefertiti, and both groups were sent after the Sceptre of Nefertiti, which was taken from the Foundation members after a skirmish. [The Sceptre Deception] During the mission to secure the Amulets of Vlad Dracul, three of his Suits were transformed through the power of Overmode. Even with this power, however, they were defeated when Zhalia Moon chose to side with the Huntik Foundation. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

sections.heading: Rassimov's Suits
sections.text:
DeFoe's former Suits were placed under Rassimov and given an improved arsenal of Titans. They were then sent by Rassimov to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, who were working at a burger joint in Venice, Italy. The Suits were defeated by Lok and Sophie, who were joined by Zhalia Moon. [All Work and No Pay]

Two of the recruits from Paris, also formerly under DeFoe, were sent by Rassimov in an attempt to eliminate Sophie Casterwill and company. They failed to hinder the Foundation members, however. More of his Suits, who had infiltrated the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, confronted the Foundation team but were swiftly defeated. [Memory Lane]

His own team of Suits were then sent by the Professor to the coasts of Turkey in search for the Ring of Behemoth. Though two of his Suits were overpowering the native Amazons, they were defeated by Dante, Lok, and Sophie. Rassimov later joined his team, but the Suits were defeated Dante received the Ring of Behemoth from Zhalia Moon. [Ladies' Choice]

Rassimov and his suits travelled to the Temple of Poseidon to beat Dante's team to the Amulet of Will but were unable to stop them from getting through the entrance to Atlantis. [The Unseen Guide] Upon eventually catching up with the Huntik team at the Casterwill compound, they fought against Zhalia and Sophie while Lok and Rassimov battled one-on-one. They were defeated however, with numerous Suits being turned to stone by King Basilisk. [Coming of Age]

Rassimov and his team along with the Professor and his two elite agents travelled to King Solomon's Mines on the trail of the Ring of Tao. They pursued the Huntik team and their guide Otto via car but were stopped when Metagolem demolished the Ndago bridge. They later attacked the team in the desert before taking Zhalia and Otto prisoner. [The Golden Asp] After entering the Mines, two of Rassimov's suits were deployed to stop the team but failed. Later the Suits fought aginst the Huntik team and Montehue and Tersly. Despite overpowering the Foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when Lok bonded with Tao. [To Be Together]

A number of Rassimov's Suits were positioned at The Professor's castle but were defeated by the Dante's team. [The Divine Comedy]

sections.heading: The Professor's Suits
sections.text:
The Professor and his two elite agents travelled to King Solomon's Mines on the trail of the Ring of Tao. [The Golden Asp] After entering the Mines, the Suits fought aginst the Huntik team and Montehue and Tersly. Despite overpowering the Foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when Lok bonded with Tao. [To Be Together]

The two agents later attacked Dante's house and left the team considerably injured and worse for wear. [The Secret of Two Generations] They fought against the team at the Professor's castle but were defeated. [The Divine Comedy]

Following the Professor's defeat, the two agents attacked the Huntik team after they broke into Organisation central but were defeated. [Doorway to Huntik]

Under the command of Wilder and Hoffman, the two agents defended the Professor's castle from Dante and Grier before being defeated. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: The Suits' greatest asset is their sheer numbers, but they also make capable spies and are excellent at gathering information. In a battle, the Suits fight with a variety of spells and Titans. Just as the Organization brings about cold, unfeeling order with the help of savage evil deeds, its troops fight with Titans such as the cold [[Mindrone]] and the savage [[Redcap]].

full_text:
__NOTOC__
This page is to help organize information about the different Suit teams in order to expound upon the current information.
----

 
Suits are the lowest level minions of the Organization. Typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level Organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

== History ==
Most Suits were banded together by the Professor, practically overnight, through the use of Araknos' mind control ability. [The Secret of Two Generations]

=== DeFoe's Suits ===
DeFoe had his Suits pursue Lok Lambert in an attempt to retrieve Eathon Lambert's journal and its secrets of the Amulet of Will. [A Seeker Is Born] Pursuing the Foundation's clue regarding the Golem, the Organization gained Jodis Lore's Key. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] The team was later sent to Rouen, France, to retrieve Gar-Ghoul. [Into the River of Secrets]

However, they missed the more important information on the Ring of Arc and were then sent by the Professor to Paris, France, following Dante's team into the Paris Catacombs. [Crawling the Catacombs] Despite gaining a number of new recruits from Paris, they were unsuccessful at retrieving the Ring. [Divide and Conquer]

His Suits were later sent after King Basilisk, but lost the Titan to Zhalia Moon. They also lost unnamed Suit 001 to a petrification trap within the Titan's chamber. [Absent Heroes]

Upon this failure, DeFoe lost command of his original team of Suits and thus had to rally his remaining loyal Suits within Velo, Greece, in an attempt to finally get his revenge on Dante Vale. This team failed and were escorted back under Grier. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

=== Grier's Suits ===
Upon taking DeFoe's place of leadership within the Organization, Grier had his Suits accompany him to Sutos Island in order to reclaim the rulership of the island. The Suits were led into a trap by Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, and the two sides battled until Dante Vale and Grier announced a truce. His Suits were then permitted to help enforce order on Sutos in order to promote peace on the island. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Two of Grier's Suits were attacked by four Silent Soldiers while loading a boat with supplies for Sutos. They were saved by Dante's team. Grier acknowledged that not all his men had been so lucky. His Suits later accompanied him to the Professor's Castle. [An Ally from the Organization]

=== Klaus's Suits ===
Klaus' Viennese Suits were sent, under the instructions of Rassimov, to go after Dante Vale in County Kerry, Ireland. His team of Suits ambushed Scarlet Byrne and Dante's team in the New Grange Passage Tomb but were eventually defeated. [Home Turf] His Egyptian Suits were sent to excavate the tomb of Nefertiti, and both groups were sent after the Sceptre of Nefertiti, which was taken from the Foundation members after a skirmish. [The Sceptre Deception] During the mission to secure the Amulets of Vlad Dracul, three of his Suits were transformed through the power of Overmode. Even with this power, however, they were defeated when Zhalia Moon chose to side with the Huntik Foundation. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

=== Rassimov's Suits ===
DeFoe's former Suits were placed under Rassimov and given an improved arsenal of Titans. They were then sent by Rassimov to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, who were working at a burger joint in Venice, Italy. The Suits were defeated by Lok and Sophie, who were joined by Zhalia Moon. [All Work and No Pay]

Two of the recruits from Paris, also formerly under DeFoe, were sent by Rassimov in an attempt to eliminate Sophie Casterwill and company. They failed to hinder the Foundation members, however. More of his Suits, who had infiltrated the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, confronted the Foundation team but were swiftly defeated. [Memory Lane]

His own team of Suits were then sent by the Professor to the coasts of Turkey in search for the Ring of Behemoth. Though two of his Suits were overpowering the native Amazons, they were defeated by Dante, Lok, and Sophie. Rassimov later joined his team, but the Suits were defeated Dante received the Ring of Behemoth from Zhalia Moon. [Ladies' Choice]

Rassimov and his suits travelled to the Temple of Poseidon to beat Dante's team to the Amulet of Will but were unable to stop them from getting through the entrance to Atlantis. [The Unseen Guide] Upon eventually catching up with the Huntik team at the Casterwill compound, they fought against Zhalia and Sophie while Lok and Rassimov battled one-on-one. They were defeated however, with numerous Suits being turned to stone by King Basilisk. [Coming of Age]

Rassimov and his team along with the Professor and his two elite agents travelled to King Solomon's Mines on the trail of the Ring of Tao. They pursued the Huntik team and their guide Otto via car but were stopped when Metagolem demolished the Ndago bridge. They later attacked the team in the desert before taking Zhalia and Otto prisoner. [The Golden Asp] After entering the Mines, two of Rassimov's suits were deployed to stop the team but failed. Later the Suits fought aginst the Huntik team and Montehue and Tersly. Despite overpowering the Foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when Lok bonded with Tao. [To Be Together]

A number of Rassimov's Suits were positioned at The Professor's castle but were defeated by the Dante's team. [The Divine Comedy]

=== The Professor's Suits ===
The Professor and his two elite agents travelled to King Solomon's Mines on the trail of the Ring of Tao. [The Golden Asp] After entering the Mines, the Suits fought aginst the Huntik team and Montehue and Tersly. Despite overpowering the Foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when Lok bonded with Tao. [To Be Together]

The two agents later attacked Dante's house and left the team considerably injured and worse for wear. [The Secret of Two Generations] They fought against the team at the Professor's castle but were defeated. [The Divine Comedy]

Following the Professor's defeat, the two agents attacked the Huntik team after they broke into Organisation central but were defeated. [Doorway to Huntik]

Under the command of Wilder and Hoffman, the two agents defended the Professor's castle from Dante and Grier before being defeated. [An Ally from the Organization]

=== Wilder's Suits ===

== Abilities ==
The Suits' greatest asset is their sheer numbers, but they also make capable spies and are excellent at gathering information. In a battle, the Suits fight with a variety of spells and Titans. Just as the Organization brings about cold, unfeeling order with the help of savage evil deeds, its troops fight with Titans such as the cold Mindrone and the savage Redcap.

In several episodes, several of the Suits were digitally "cloned" in order to give the appearance of more Suits. Though many appeared alongside their doppleganger, their status as a separate Suit may be up for debate.
